comparisonToTheSameRecipeAtGen1.note: gen-1's own round is the same recipe, the same model, the same suite and the same harness at the same rlmx HEAD (6ec4822), started 84 minutes earlier (2026-07-27T08:22:45Z vs 09:46:15Z). The delta below is run-to-run variance, not a prompt effect.
comparisonToTheSameRecipeAtGen1.consequence: a +3-fact swing on an identical (recipe, model, suite) triple is larger than the entire spread of the four recorded generations ([28, 29, 28, 29]). Single-round fitness differences of 1-2 facts are inside noise and cannot be used to select a prompt on their own.

deviationsWorthReading: task 6 fanned out ZERO times and ran to the 14-iteration cap in 74.9s, and still scored 5/5 with 13/13 citations resolving. gen-1's task 6 fanned out 4 times. The mandatory fan-out is not reliably mandatory at this model.
task 4 rose from 4/6 to 6/6 while its citation count rose from 11 to 34 — the gain is real (both RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION and RECORD_KIND are now named) but it came with a 3x wider citation set.
task 3 F5 (npu_power.py:84) has now missed in every single recorded round, gen-0 through gen-3 and here. It is the one fact no configuration of this recipe has ever produced.

headlineDoesNotReproduce.published: facts 32/34, fitness 0.9412, tasksPassed 4/6 — with task 4 at 6/6
headlineDoesNotReproduce.whatIsStillTrue: this round really did score 32/34. runs/, logs/, round.json and summary.* are the honest record of ONE execution and nothing in them is being retracted.
headlineDoesNotReproduce.whatIsWithdrawn: treating 32/34 as this arm's LEVEL. It is the maximum of the observations available for this (recipe, model, suite) triple, and it did not reproduce.
headlineDoesNotReproduce.replicates: three live re-runs of task 4 on the identical triple (recipe gens/gen-1 02184f35 + agent.yaml 20f8e018, model khal/deepseek-v4-flash, round2-train/4.md) scored 3/6, 5/6, 4/6 against the 6/6 published here
headlineDoesNotReproduce.howTheBandIsComputed: hold the five non-task-4 tasks at their published values (6+5+5+5+5 = 26 facts) and substitute each replicate for task 4: 26+3=29, 26+4=30, 26+5=31. The other five tasks were not replicated, so the band is a lower bound on the true spread, not an interval estimate.
headlineDoesNotReproduce.replicateRecordsNotCommitted: the three replicates were executed live by the campaign verifier; their run/score JSON is NOT committed under this wish. Only the scored task-4 totals are on record. The band is verifier-reported and cannot be re-derived from this tree — the numbers above are the whole evidence.
headlineDoesNotReproduce.consequenceForThisArmsOwnConclusion: STRENGTHENED, not weakened. `comparisonToTheSameRecipeAtGen1.consequence` already says single-round differences of 1-2 facts are inside noise and cannot select a prompt. The replicates show the same task swinging 3/6 to 6/6 with nothing changed but the clock, so the honest statement is stronger: single-round differences of up to ~3 facts on this triple are inside noise.

spawnsGuardCaveat.observed: task 6 of THIS arm fanned out ZERO times (spawns=0), on the recipe that was selected (gen-1, 02184f35)
spawnsGuardCaveat.whyItMatters: EVOLUTION.md's gen-3 entry pre-registered 'Spawns must return to >= 3 on every run' as a hard guard, and recipeUnderTest.whyThisGeneration above cites gen-3's spawns=2 on tasks 3 and 4 as a reason gen-3 does not displace gen-1. The same condition holds on the selected recipe: spawns=0 here (task 6), spawns=2 on task 3 of the pro arm, spawns=2 on task 3 of the qwen arm — 3 of the 4 matrix arms running gen-1's exact snapshot break the guard, and gen-0, the shipped recipe, ran 2/2/0 on tasks 3/4/6.
spawnsGuardCaveat.corrected: spawns<3 is a property of a round (model, load, question), not of a prompt. That bullet is withdrawn as a selection reason; the selection itself is unchanged, on the ground that a tie does not displace the incumbent.
spawnsGuardCaveat.seeAlso: EVOLUTION.md — 'Guard 3 is real, and it does not separate gen-3 from the recipe that was selected'
